title: 0.2.13 BOM finish flow polish
summary: This update improves the BOM processing finish step. Processed BOM files are broadcast to history pickers immediately, and the finish page now has a clear action to close the current BOM workflow and start a fresh one.
highlights: The BOM processing deliver page now includes a Finish and start new BOM action.
Clicking finish refreshes reusable history BOM data immediately, so BOM Compare and SMT Package Check can select the newly processed BOM without a manual page refresh.
Finishing a BOM clears the saved BOM processing workspace and returns the wizard to the first source step.
The finish action removes stale Cadence source/name URL parameters, so browser refresh no longer jumps back into the completed BOM.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing processed BOM history remains available.
